description: Fetch and parse sitemap XML or gzip into JSON. For an index, follow the first N children with ?follow=N. Caps merged output at 500 URLs. Paid per call: $0.005 in USDC via x402.

follow.description: For a sitemap index, fetch and merge the first N children (default 0)

url.description: Public HTTP(S) sitemap URL, including .xml.gz, or a site origin to try /sitemap.xml

name: sitemap
